seriesName: AI compute per Cerebras wafer, by chip generation
notes: All three figures come from one published comparison table on a single ServeTheHome page covering the CS-4 launch, so the chart rests on one source. The numbers are the vendor's own sparse FP16 peak-compute claims as reported by ServeTheHome, not independently measured benchmarks, and sparse FP16 peak figures are not directly comparable to GPU vendors' headline numbers. The CS-4 system packs three WSE-3 Turbo wafers, so the system-level figure is 750 PFLOPS, three times the per-wafer value shown here.
